summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed after print) as a thin wrapper that joins str() of objects with sep and calls self.print with emoji/markup off, no_wrap on, overflow="ignore", crop off, passing end, style, and highlight (default True). Added the CHANGELOG bullet "Added Console.out" under 9.0.0 Added, a "Low level output" section in docs/source/console.rst after Logging, and tests in tests/test_console.py (test_out plus test_out_* aspect tests, with new RenderHook and Text imports at the top). Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests are unverified. Nothing committed.
